Three requested changes

1. Program-level profile policy

Head can require Latin primary names and choose offered grades. The verified setting requires Latin names and offers grades 9–12.

  • English and Chinese settings
  • Desktop and mobile layouts
  • Immediate public-form propagation

2. Focused user management

The users table is reduced to five columns. Academic information lives inside User details, while all row actions share one visual contract.

  • Emma’s G10 / 26-27 / class 2029 record
  • Loaded policy history
  • Equal action typography and widths

3. One academic reference year

The shared profile editor uses the current program year instead of an editable year. Grade 10 in 26-27 computes class 2029.

  • Only grades 9–12 offered
  • No editable reference-year field
  • Same behavior in account and signup flows
